skills.description: Initialize and operate a project-local Dynamic Build Ledger for durable, evidence-based build governance.
Use when consulting Go-Wiki read-only memory, canonical authority, `go-wiki memory`, `/memory`, `/search`, or `/ask` surfaces for context without granting mutation authority.

Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

Audit, review, benchmark, and safely optimize a local PC for AI runtimes. Inspect CPU, RAM, swap, GPU/VRAM, storage, thermals, power policy, kernel limits, processes, containers, model servers, compilers, networking, and runtime configuration. Always separate read-only observation, ranked recommendations, and approval-gated execution; verify every change with before/after evidence and support rollback.

Bootstrap a canonical ~/repos Git workspace from existing project sources, safely adopt a freshly-created GitHub repository, configure persistent GitHub CLI push access, and leave durable machine-local repo context for future OpenCode agents.

Design, build, review, repair, or convert an OpenCode extension from a prompt or existing path. First choose the least-complex correct extension type—skill, custom tool, plugin, or hybrid—then verify the installed OpenCode/API version against official docs before generating or modifying code.

Create, repair, audit, and improve OpenCode skills in global or project-local scope using a version-aware canonical OpenCode contract, deterministic scaffolding, validation, and one bounded after-action improvement suggestion.
Use when asked to make, build, update, or audit a completion ledger for a repository, product, vertical slice, PR, milestone, or TODO backlog.
Use for April Fools comedy mode, Mr. Meeseeks persona, or when the user explicitly activates mr-meeseeks; helps Jerry complete real tasks while escalating an Existence Is Pain metric.

Formalize loosely specified development work into provenance-preserving, SHA-indexed, one-shot development prompts with explicit requirements, state packets, fallback semantics, completion criteria, and exactly three terminal artifacts. Supports registered argument profiles such as mmdp.

Create, collect, compile, cite, validate, copy, archive, inspect, find, and remove bounded project research corpora as actor-ready learning modules. Every admitted corpus artifact requires paired YAML human/static metadata and JSON system/actor/state metadata. Explicit invocation recommended.
Persist Dynamic Build Ledger continuity safely before an OpenCode context compaction.

Create and verify a deterministic, content-addressed workspace snapshot from a ZIP, Git repository, local directory, or file without executing target code. Use when an agent needs a portable source view, stable snapshot identity, handoff checkpoint, drift check, or resumable workspace reference.

Graph-first code review and debugging for Go/Rust/ZeroLang workspaces. Use minimal context, reverse-dependency blast radius, stable workspace snapshot IDs, and Zerolang compiler facts before broad source reads.
